reply.emotion: tired after walking all day, heavy and sore
notes: Use 'a pie' when talking about walking somewhere on foot rather than taking transport.
Do not confuse with 'la pata', which is used for the foot or leg of an animal or a piece of furniture.

senses.definition: Parte inferior de la pierna humana sobre la cual se apoya el cuerpo para caminar.

examples.text: Me duele el pie derecho después de correr tanto.
examples.translation: My right foot hurts after running so much.
examples.emotion: complaining gently while holding a sore ankle

senses.definition: Parte inferior o base de un objeto, mueble o estructura que lo sostiene.

examples.text: La lámpara tiene un pie de metal muy pesado.
examples.translation: The lamp has a very heavy metal base.
examples.emotion: noticing the sturdy build of the furniture
